title: Parity
statement: Sieves count almost-primes better than primes; no unconditional sieve isolates primes alone.

title: Minor-arc
statement: Major-arc structure must be matched by minor-arc cancellation.

title: Zero-free
statement: Strong distribution errors require zero-free regions.

title: Siegel-zero
statement: Possible exceptional zeros create ineffectivity and bias.

title: Positivity/Weil
statement: RH is equivalent to Weil positivity; explicit formulas transfer the problem to zeros but do not locate them.

title: Artin
statement: Artin L-functions require holomorphy and zero-control.

title: Convexity/Lindelof
statement: Convexity/Lindelof boundary; weaker than RH, stronger than convexity.

title: Sieve ceiling
statement: The sixth wall is empty: no unconditional sieve reaches RH; only EH crosses.

title: Off-diagonal
statement: The off-diagonal term is distinct from PNT-error and from parity.

title: Density hypothesis
statement: Floor of OP-001: the density hypothesis, 17/30 = 1 - 1/A.

title: Convergence to Xi
statement: Convergence wall of Hurwitz toward Xi.

title: Pretentious phase wall
statement: A multiplicative function shows cancellation only when its phase is far (Halasz/pretentious distance) from n^{it}; small distance means no cancellation.

title: Average vs normal order
statement: Average order does not imply pointwise/normal order; concentration and cancellation are separate.
